description:
## Why

First real artefact from the harness. Establishes a known-good baseline against which future regressions are measured.

## What

1. Run `pkix-difftest run pkits pkix-path/tests/pkits --oracles pkix-path,openssl,pyca --output-md pkix-difftest/baseline-pkits.md --output-json pkix-difftest/baseline-pkits.json`.
2. Inspect the divergence report. For every `LooserThanWild` and `StricterThanWild`, classify by hand:
   - Real bug in pkix-path → file a follow-up bead, link from baseline.
   - Intentional spec stricture → note in baseline.
   - Oracle quirk → note in baseline.
3. Commit `baseline-pkits.md` and `baseline-pkits.json` (the .json is the source of truth; .md is human-readable summary).

## Acceptance

- [ ] All 249 PKITS vectors produce a verdict from each oracle (no harness errors).
- [ ] `baseline-pkits.md` committed with the divergence report.
- [ ] `baseline-pkits.json` committed.
- [ ] Every `LooserThanWild` entry either has a follow-up bead filed or a written-out justification in the baseline.
- [ ] Every `StricterThanWild` entry either has a justification or a follow-up bead.
- [ ] PKITS ground-truth disagreements (where harness verdict differs from `ShouldValidate`) are surfaced as a top-level section.

## Notes

- This is where the harness actually proves its worth. Expect surprises.
- Baseline files should be diff-friendly (sorted, deterministic ordering, no timestamps in committed output).
